text: yeah so under the UV unwrapping in this route, is a perfect place to store the meta data of the layer. since a layer carries the pivot/joint but our layer component is not really built for this type of extra data
resolution: Layer rig metadata moved to workspace column 3, under the UV unwrap (req_1053). The outliner is a reused paint LayerStrip (name + visibility only) and isn't built to hold the extra per-layer data a part now carries (pivot + named joints). New RigMetaPanel.tsx renders as the RIG group in workbench/model/source.tsx, directly under the UV group: it shows the active part's pivot (address .pivot, position read-only) and its joints as an inline editor — editable name (the binding key, committed on blur, auto-uniquified), type, axis (X/Y/Z), and rotation limit (min/max degrees or a full toggle), plus add/remove. It reads and writes the shared studio store via updatePartMesh, so it never diverges from the column-4 viewport. This sets a clean split: column 3 = the metadata (names/types/limits), the viewport gizmo = spatial placement. The old floating viewport joint panel was removed to avoid duplication. editMesh 41/41, Studio + full workbench source chain bundle clean; hot-reload TSX, uncommitted. Spec in PLAYBOOK Part 6.1c.
